description: This file contains implementation of cryptographic and identity support functions for Android, including key generation, encryption, decryption, signature, and certificate handling, primarily for use in identity credential support within the Android hardware identity support framework.

methods.name: eicMemSet
methods.description: Wrapper around memset for memory setting.

methods.name: eicMemCpy
methods.description: Wrapper around memcpy for memory copying.

methods.name: eicStrLen
methods.description: Wrapper around strlen for string length.

methods.name: eicCryptoMemCmp
methods.description: Wrapper around CRYPTO_memcmp for constant-time memory comparison.

methods.description: Updates HMAC-SHA256 with data.

methods.description: Finalizes HMAC-SHA256 and outputs digest.

methods.description: Updates SHA256 hash with data.
